integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] ONE UNINTERRUPTED TEN-SECOND live-action martial-arts fight at brisk real-time speed. Powerful full-body punches visibly knock the recipient off balance. The same two adult human actors, exact Goku on the LEFT and shorter Vegeta on the RIGHT, fight in the same dry sunlit rocky canyon. Preserve their faces, black hairstyles, height difference, orange cotton gi, navy undersuit, ivory-and-ochre armor, white gloves and boots, and Vegeta's wrapped brown tail. Preserve the human skin and tangible fabrics of the first photograph.

Opening third: They burst forward from their guards. Vegeta drives a hard left jab that Goku parries, then plants his lead boot and explosively rotates his rear hip into a right cross against Goku's raised forearm guard. The white glove strikes the braced forearm for one brief impact, jolting the entire guard into Goku's chest. Goku's shoulders and hips are knocked backward together; his rear foot is forced to take a clear catching step. Vegeta has already pulled the glove back as Goku catches his weight. Goku immediately plants and turns his hips into a compact counterpunch against Vegeta's elbow shield, buckling that shield inward and forcing Vegeta's trunk and planted leg to absorb the blow.

Middle third: Goku pushes off his rear boot, transfers his weight forward and fires two short alternating power punches into Vegeta's high guard. Each collision sharply jerks Vegeta's shoulders backward and forces a distinct retreating support step; his guard is driven inward rather than remaining rigid. Vegeta slips the next straight, pivots on his planted boot and explosively turns his whole torso into a short hook to Goku's exposed ribs. The glove hits the ribs, immediately recoils, and Goku's ribcage twists away AFTER the contact. His hips follow the rotation and an urgent lateral step prevents him falling. Goku regains his footing and answers with a short hook that knocks Vegeta's blocking forearm into his own shoulder.

Final third: Vegeta plants firmly, punches high into Goku's guard and immediately drops his weight into a rear-hand body punch. His leg drive and hip rotation launch the glove sharply into Goku's abdomen. At the brief contact the orange cloth dents, then Goku's stomach and trunk involuntarily fold around the blow. Vegeta's fist is already retracting while Goku's hips are knocked backward and his boots make two urgent catching steps, with a short heel skid and displaced dirt. Goku remains hunched from the hit as he pivots away and recovers his guard; Vegeta pursues in grounded fighting footwork. End during that active recovery and pursuit.

Show distinct sharp collisions and involuntary whole-body recoil. A strike is a sudden impulse, not prolonged pushing: accelerate, collide briefly, retract immediately, and show the recipient's momentum continue after the fist has left. Shoulders, ribcage and hips respond, not just the hands. Force comes from planted feet, leg drive and hip rotation. Preserve solid single arms and readable anatomy. Maintain the restrained lateral waist-height camera, full bodies, visible foot support, canyon geography, daylight and natural real-time speed. Hair, cloth and modest dust follow the body's motion. Pure practical bodily combat.
